ios.desc:
MyIPNow is an all-in-one IP lookup, DNS lookup, WHOIS, blacklist checker, subnet calculator and speed test app for iPhone and iPad.

Check your public IPv4 and IPv6 instantly, analyze domains and networks, test latency, generate secure passwords, and export results - all in a fast, privacy-first toolkit designed for network engineers, developers, sysadmins, and privacy-conscious users.

No accounts. No data sold.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

- See your IPv4 and IPv6 instantly on the home screen, with location, ISP, and ASN details
- Run IP, DNS, WHOIS, and Blacklist lookups for any address or domain
- Bulk lookups: paste a list, upload a file, or use the clipboard - process up to 10 entries free, unlimited with Pro
- Export results as CSV or PDF with properly formatted tables
- Test ping latency to any host
- Run download and upload speed tests
- Calculate subnets, network ranges, and CIDR
- Look up ASN information for any IP
- Generate strong passwords with custom rules
- Hide your IP with built-in VPN recommendations

LOOKUP HISTORY
Every lookup is saved automatically. Free users keep the last 10 entries per tool, Pro users get unlimited history. Re-run any past lookup with one tap.

FOR NETWORK PROS
- Bulk processing for batch audits
- CSV and PDF export with styled tables for client reports
- ASN, ISP, country, city, and coordinate data on every IP
- Real-time blacklist checks across major DNSBLs
- WHOIS data with registrar, registrant, creation, and expiry dates

PRO FEATURES
Upgrade to Pro for:
- Unlimited bulk lookups across tools
- Unlimited lookup history
- Full CSV and PDF export with formatted tables
- Ad-free experience
- Priority API access for faster results

Available as monthly, yearly, or one-time lifetime purchase.

WHY MYIPNOW

- Native iOS app - no ads ruining the layout, no clunky web wrappers
- Dark theme designed for long sessions
- Works in landscape on iPad
- Fast: 5-second timeout on slow networks, smart fallback for IPv6

KEY FEATURES SUMMARY

IP lookup tool, DNS lookup tool, WHOIS lookup tool, blacklist checker, speed test, ping test, subnet calculator, CIDR calculator, and network diagnostics in one app.

SUPPORT

Email contact@myipnow.net or visit myipnow.net for support, the web version, and our browser extensions for Chrome and Firefox.
